items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: No matter was song she sang, I always had something to say to her, like what Bob Hope is doing it now.

ctx.x: And the house caved. It shocked her so much, she damn near forgot the lyrics, so the house caved in and from then on she never looked back. Standing ovation. You know, each show was different. I never said the same thing twice. It wasn't no set routine. I said anything that come in my mind, you know, to fit the thing. And she was so surprised and

Irving Mills was surprised and it was a feature, the people ate it up, and from then on we were just like ham and eggs, Ivie and I. No matter was song she sang, I always had something to say to her, like what Bob Hope is doing it now. Current events, any kind of event come off, I would slide it in there.

I had friends that was in business, different business, the guys would come up and say, 'Sonny, give me a plug,' Okay, I would insert it. Yeah, liquor store, I don't care, anything. Hairdressers, anything, I would slide it in there, you know.
